name: Abdul Jalil
contribution: Mohammad Abdul Jalil was an Awami League politician, former minister, and long-serving parliamentarian from Naogaon.
context: He developed through student politics, held senior party responsibilities, and served as Awami League general secretary from 2002 to 2009.
impact: His career shows how post-independence party organisation connected local electoral work with national leadership.
